required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 20 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Did startup commands confirm `F:\reverse-agent`, repo root, and clean or explicitly baselined `git status --short` before any project gate?
Was `startup-snapshot` still the immediate sixth command and first project gate?
Did `decision_meta` remain valid and `APPROVED` on `engineering_branch` with active `reverse-agent-iteration@v2`?
Did Codex treat `decision_packet.md` as authority and `task_packet.json` as background only?
Were `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `.github/workflows/state-gate.yml` inspected only as read-only evidence?
Was `project_state/gates/ci_workflow_coverage_result.json` generated with current decision ID, round ID, and report ID?

What workflow coverage does the artifact report for baseline pytest, `tests/test_project_reports.py`, preflight, command-plan, local-execution-bundle, codex-prompt-packet, audit-precheck, report-summary, execution-log, and final-check?
What unsafe workflow capabilities does the artifact check for, and were any found?
Do tests fail when required workflow coverage is missing from synthetic workflow content?
Do tests fail when unsafe workflow patterns are present in synthetic workflow content?
Did implementation stay within allowed source/test files and generated artifacts?
Were forbidden and preserve-only files not modified?
Did local execution bundle remain current, evidence-only, non-executable, non-dispatching, non-mutating, and command-plan aligned?
Did codex prompt packet remain current and non-executable?
Did audit precheck preserve `READY_FOR_GPT_AUDIT` and `DO_NOT_ACCEPT`/blocking semantics?
Did report-summary match pytest, changed files, generated artifacts, decision ID, round ID, and new workflow coverage artifact status?
Did execution-log align with command-plan and pytest_result, with no omitted command executed?
Did final-check pass?
Did run-closeout pass, close-round become `CLOSED`, and post-closeout final-check pass?
Did the report clearly state that workflow files were not modified and that any workflow coverage gaps are input for a future decision?
